title: Display safe-region overlays and violations
description: Continuously show distinct label-boundary, requested safe-area, content-region, and violation overlays in label and sheet previews while preserving identical printable scene layout and equivalent textual diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Label and sheet previews visually distinguish label boundary, requested safe area, content region, and offending elements
Overlay toggles alter display aids only and never mutate, clip, rescale, or reflow printable scene geometry
Equivalent textual diagnostics remain available when overlays are hidden
Warnings use text and icon cues in addition to color and associate affected assignments/elements with controls
Continuous validation updates after relevant edits without stale results or blocking ordinary input

steps.details: Map SafeRegionResult and SceneViolation values to preview-only SVG paths and stable accessible labels outside the printable-scene input.
Add semantic toggles plus a textual violation list naming page, position, element, and reason with visible focus and announced updates.
Recompute from normalized scene and safety inputs after relevant edits using the existing responsive update seam; discard stale results by input identity.
Toggle overlays at multiple zooms and viewports, compare normalized printable geometry before/after, and verify keyboard access and non-color diagnostics in both previews.

technicalNotes: Limit the ten-minute increment to simple SVG overlay paths and the existing diagnostics panel.
Preview masks and overlays are explanatory software aids, never proof of physical placement or containment.
